findings.result: AuthReply private fields bind original request, actual TLS participant, cluster, destination, start, deadline and child cancellation. HostObservation has no Deserialize/Clone/raw DTO constructor; from_transport consumes sealed reply, revalidates evidence/request/peer pins, and retains original deadline.

ReadAdmission::HostMember validates actual caller certificate/incarnation and Active registered membership before begin and again when fresh authority is ready. Existing shared contexts/workers and parent deadlines are reused.
Host member request may be Voter or Learner; metadata quorum remains actual context voters. No generic range observation or recovery-role conversion is exposed.

Only HostMember skips same_range_read_authority on final subject. Membership is rechecked and metadata leader/term/current-pending quorum still come from begin/probe/finish. Range epoch changes are allowed for data-only metadata observation.
TLS-authenticated caller is captured under topology guard; guard is dropped before provider network acquisition. Host request is intercepted before DB/data-service operation dispatch.

limits: Bounded source assessment, not additional dynamic execution or physical timing qualification.
Observation is not durable lease, writer/read permission or recovery role.
No independent-process or physical-VM experiment in Host23.
No retained DB roots or external acknowledgement ledger for Host23.
